name: freshness-differences-doc-socket-arm-imprecise
body: `freshness_differences_with`'s doc lists `"socket"` among the `NotApplicable` precondition labels, but by construction a lone `"socket"` label reaches `Stale` — the database and HEAD sha are both present — and only a combined no-HEAD case could fold a socket failure into `NotApplicable`; correct that doc line when the phase is reviewed.
